verses.original: Βίβλος γενέσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ υἱοῦ Δαυὶδ υἱοῦ Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: Biblos geneseōs Iēsou Christou huiou Dauid huiou Abraam
verses.literal: This is the record of the genealogy of Jesus Christ the son of David the son of Abraham
verses.literalPt: Livro da geração de Jesus Cristo, filho de Davi, filho de Abraão.

verses.original: Ἀβραὰμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰσαάκ Ἰσαὰκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰούδαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Abraam egennēsen ton Isaak Isaak de egennēsen ton Iakōb Iakōb de egennēsen ton Ioudan kai tous adelphous autou
verses.literal: Abraham was the father of Isaac Isaac the father of Jacob and Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers
verses.literalPt: Abraão gerou a Isaque; Isaque gerou a Jacó; Jacó gerou a Judá e a seus irmãos;

verses.original: Ἰούδας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φαρὲς καὶ τὸν Ζαρὰ ἐκ τῆς Θάμαρ Φαρὲς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑσρώμ Ἑσρὼμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀράμ
verses.transliteration: Ioudas de egennēsen ton Phares kai ton Zara ek tēs Thamar Phares de egennēsen ton Hesrōm Hesrōm de egennēsen ton Aram
verses.literal: Judah was the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar Perez the father of Hezron and Hezron the father of Ram
verses.literalPt: Judá gerou de Tamar a Perez e a Zara; Perez gerou a Esrom; Esrom gerou a Arão;

verses.original: Ἀρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμιναδάβ Ἀμιναδὰβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναασσών Ναασσὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλμών
verses.transliteration: Aram de egennēsen ton Aminadab Aminadab de egennēsen ton Naassōn Naassōn de egennēsen ton Salmōn
verses.literal: Ram was the father of Amminadab Amminadab the father of Nahshon and Nahshon the father of Salmon
verses.literalPt: Arão gerou a Aminadabe; Aminadabe gerou a Naassom; Naassom gerou a Salmom;

verses.original: Σαλμὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Βόες ἐκ τῆς Ῥαχάβ Βόες δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωβὴδ ἐκ τῆς Ῥούθ Ἰωβὴδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεσσαί
verses.transliteration: Salmōn de egennēsen ton Boes ek tēs Rhachab Boes de egennēsen ton Iōbēd ek tēs Rhouth Iōbēd de egennēsen ton Iessai
verses.literal: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth Obed the father of Jesse
verses.literalPt: Salmom gerou de Raabe a Boaz; Boaz gerou de Rute a Obede; Obede gerou a Jessé,

verses.original: Ἰεσσαὶ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Δαυὶδ τὸν βασιλέα Δαυὶδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σολομῶνα ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Οὐρίου
verses.transliteration: Iessai de egennēsen ton Dauid ton basilea Dauid de egennēsen ton Solomōna ek tēs tou Ouriou
verses.literal: and Jesse the father of David the king Next David was the father of Solomon by . . . Uriah’s wife
verses.literalPt: e Jessé gerou ao rei Davi. Davi gerou a Salomão daquela que fora mulher de Urias;

verses.original: Σολομὼν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ῥοβοάμ Ῥοβοὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιά Ἀβιὰ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀσάφ
verses.transliteration: Solomōn de egennēsen ton Rhoboam Rhoboam de egennēsen ton Abia Abia de egennēsen ton Asaph
verses.literal: Solomon the father of Rehoboam Rehoboam the father of Abijah and Abijah the father of Asa
verses.literalPt: Salomão gerou a Roboão; Roboão gerou a Abias; Abias gerou a Asa;

verses.original: Ἀσὰφ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσαφάτ Ἰωσαφὰτ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωράμ Ἰωρὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ὀζίαν
verses.transliteration: Asaph de egennēsen ton Iōsaphat Iōsaphat de egennēsen ton Iōram Iōram de egennēsen ton Ozian
verses.literal: Asa was the father of Jehoshaphat Jehoshaphat the father of Joram and Joram the father of Uzziah
verses.literalPt: Asa gerou a Josafá; Josafá gerou a Jorão; Jorão gerou a Uzias;

verses.original: Ὀζίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωαθάμ Ἰωαθὰμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἄχαζ Ἄχαζ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἑζεκίαν
verses.transliteration: Ozias de egennēsen ton Iōatham Iōatham de egennēsen ton Achaz Achaz de egennēsen ton Hezekian
verses.literal: Uzziah was the father of Jotham Jotham the father of Ahaz and Ahaz the father of Hezekiah
verses.literalPt: Uzias gerou a Jotão; Jotão gerou a Acaz; Acaz gerou a Ezequias

verses.original: Ἑζεκίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μανασσῆ Μανασσῆς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀμώς Ἀμὼς δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσίαν
verses.transliteration: Hezekias de egennēsen ton Manassē Manassēs de egennēsen ton Amōs Amōs de egennēsen ton Iōsian
verses.literal: Hezekiah was the father of Manasseh Manasseh the father of Amon Amon the father of Josiah
verses.literalPt: Ezequias gerou a Manassés; Manassés gerou a Amom; Amom gerou a Josias,

verses.original: Ἰωσίας δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰεχονίαν καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος
verses.transliteration: Iōsias de egennēsen ton Iechonian kai tous adelphous autou epi tēs metoikesias Babylōnos
verses.literal: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon
verses.literalPt: e Josias gerou a Jeconias e a seus irmãos no tempo do exílio em Babilônia.

verses.original: Μετὰ δὲ τὴν μετοικεσίαν Βαβυλῶνος Ἰεχονίας ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλαθιήλ Σαλαθιὴλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ζοροβαβέλ
verses.transliteration: Meta de tēn metoikesian Babylōnos Iechonias egennēsen ton Salathiēl Salathiēl de egennēsen ton Zorobabel
verses.literal: After . . . the exile to Babylon Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel
verses.literalPt: Depois do exílio em Babilônia, Jeconias gerou a Salatiel; Salatiel gerou a Zorobabel;

verses.original: Ζοροβαβὲλ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀβιούδ Ἀβιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιακίμ Ἐλιακὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀζώρ
verses.transliteration: Zorobabel de egennēsen ton Abioud Abioud de egennēsen ton Eliakim Eliakim de egennēsen ton Azōr
verses.literal: Zerubbabel the father of Abiud Abiud the father of Eliakim and Eliakim the father of Azor
verses.literalPt: Zorobabel gerou a Abiúde; Abiúde gerou a Eliaquim; Eliaquim gerou a Azor;

verses.original: Ἀζὼρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαδώκ Σαδὼκ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἀχίμ Ἀχὶμ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλιούδ
verses.transliteration: Azōr de egennēsen ton Sadōk Sadōk de egennēsen ton Achim Achim de egennēsen ton Elioud
verses.literal: Azor was the father of Zadok Zadok the father of Achim and Achim the father of Eliud
verses.literalPt: Azor gerou a Sadoque; Sadoque gerou a Aquim; Aquim gerou a Eliúde;

verses.original: Ἐλιοὺδ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἐλεάζαρ Ἐλεάζαρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ματθάν Ματθὰν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰακώβ
verses.transliteration: Elioud de egennēsen ton Eleazar Eleazar de egennēsen ton Matthan Matthan de egennēsen ton Iakōb
verses.literal: Eliud was the father of Eleazar Eleazar the father of Matthan Matthan the father of Jacob
verses.literalPt: Eliúde gerou a Eleazar; Eleazar gerou a Matã; Matã gerou a Jacó,

verses.original: Ἰακὼβ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ἰωσὴφ τὸν ἄνδρα Μαρίας ἐξ ἧς ἐγεννήθη Ἰησοῦς ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός
verses.transliteration: Iakōb de egennēsen ton Iōsēph ton andra Marias ex hēs egennēthē Iēsous ho legomenos Christos
verses.literal: and Jacob the father of Joseph the husband of Mary of whom was born Jesus who is called Christ
verses.literalPt: e Jacó gerou a José, esposo de Maria, da qual nasceu Jesus, que se chama Cristo.

verses.original: Πᾶσαι οὖν αἱ γενεαὶ ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἕως Δαυὶδ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες καὶ ἀπὸ Δαυὶδ ἕως τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς μετοικεσίας Βαβυλῶνος ἕως τοῦ Χριστοῦ γενεαὶ δεκατέσσαρες
verses.transliteration: Pasai oun hai geneai apo Abraam heōs Dauid geneai dekatessares kai apo Dauid heōs tēs metoikesias Babylōnos geneai dekatessares kai apo tēs metoikesias Babylōnos heōs tou Christou geneai dekatessares
verses.literal: In all then there were fourteen . . . . . . generations from Abraham to David fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon and fourteen from the exile . . . to the Christ
verses.literalPt: Assim, todas as gerações desde Abraão até Davi são catorze gerações; também, desde Davi até o exílio em Babilônia, catorze gerações; e desde o exílio em Babilônia até o Cristo, catorze gerações.

verses.original: Τοῦ δὲ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡ γένεσις οὕτως ἦν μνηστευθείσης τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Μαρίας τῷ Ἰωσήφ πρὶν ἢ συνελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εὑρέθη ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα ἐκ πνεύματος ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Tou de Iēsou Christou hē genesis houtōs ēn mnēsteutheisēs tēs mētros autou Marias tō Iōsēph prin ē synelthein autous heurethē en gastri echousa ek pneumatos hagiou
verses.literal: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about His mother Mary was pledged in marriage to Joseph but before they came together she was found to be with child . . . . . . through the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Ora, o nascimento de Jesus Cristo foi desta maneira: Estando Maria, sua mãe, já desposada com José, antes que se ajuntassem, ela se achou grávida por virtude do Espírito Santo.

verses.original: Ἰωσὴφ δὲ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς δίκαιος ὢν καὶ μὴ θέλων αὐτὴν δειγματίσαι ἐβουλήθη λάθρᾳ ἀπολῦσαι αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: Iōsēph de ho anēr autēs dikaios ōn kai mē thelōn autēn deigmatisai eboulēthē lathra apolysai autēn
verses.literal: Because Joseph her husband was a righteous man and was unwilling to disgrace her publicly he resolved to divorce her quietly
verses.literalPt: José, seu marido, sendo reto e não a querendo infamar, resolveu deixá-la secretamente.

verses.original: Ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ ἐνθυμηθέντος ἰδοὺ ἄγγελος Κυρίου κατ’ ὄναρ ἐφάνη αὐτῷ λέγων Ἰωσὴφ υἱὸς Δαυίδ μὴ φοβηθῇς παραλαβεῖν Μαρίαν τὴν γυναῖκά σου τὸ γὰρ ἐν αὐτῇ γεννηθὲν ἐκ Πνεύματός ἐστιν Ἁγίου
verses.transliteration: Tauta de autou enthymēthentos idou angelos Kyriou kat’ onar ephanē autō legōn Iōsēph huios Dauid mē phobēthēs paralabein Marian tēn gynaika sou to gar en autē gennēthen ek Pneumatos estin Hagiou
verses.literal: But after he had pondered these things an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said Joseph son of David do not be afraid . . . to embrace Mary as your wife for the One conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Quando, porém, pensava nessas coisas, eis que um anjo do Senhor lhe apareceu em sonhos, dizendo: José, filho de Davi, não temas receber a Maria, tua mulher, pois o que nela foi gerado é por virtude do Espírito Santo.

verses.original: τέξεται δὲ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν αὐτὸς γὰρ σώσει τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: texetai de huion kai kaleseis to onoma autou Iēsoun autos gar sōsei ton laon autou apo tōn hamartiōn autōn
verses.literal: She will give birth to a Son and you are to give Him the name Jesus because He will save His people from their sins
verses.literalPt: Ela dará à luz um filho, a quem chamarás JESUS, porque ele salvará o seu povo dos pecados deles.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ ὅλον γέγονεν ἵνα πληρωθῇ τὸ ῥηθὲν ὑπὸ Κυρίου διὰ τοῦ προφήτου λέγοντος
verses.transliteration: Touto de holon gegonen hina plērōthē to rhēthen hypo Kyriou dia tou prophētou legontos
verses.literal: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet
verses.literalPt: Ora, tudo isto aconteceu, para que se cumprisse o que dissera o Senhor pelo profeta:

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει καὶ τέξεται υἱόν καὶ καλέσουσιν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ ὅ ἐστιν μεθερμηνευόμενον Μεθ’ ἡμῶν ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: Idou hē parthenos en gastri hexei kai texetai huion kai kalesousin to onoma autou Emmanouēl ho estin methermēneuomenon Meth’ hēmōn ho Theos
verses.literal: Behold the virgin will be with child . . . . . . and will give birth to a son and they will call Him . . . Immanuel ( which means . . . God with us
verses.literalPt: Eis que a virgem conceberá e dará à luz um filho, e ele será chamado Emanuel, que quer dizer Deus conosco.

verses.original: Ἐγερθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωσὴφ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου ἐποίησεν ὡς προσέταξεν αὐτῷ ὁ ἄγγελος Κυρίου καὶ παρέλαβεν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Egertheis de ho Iōsēph apo tou hypnou epoiēsen hōs prosetaxen autō ho angelos Kyriou kai parelaben tēn gynaika autou
verses.literal: When Joseph woke up . . . . . . . . . he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife
verses.literalPt: José, tendo despertado do sono, fez como o anjo do Senhor lhe ordenara e recebeu sua mulher;

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἐγίνωσκεν αὐτὴν ἕως οὗ ἔτεκεν υἱόν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: kai ouk eginōsken autēn heōs hou eteken huion kai ekalesen to onoma autou Iēsoun
verses.literal: But he had no union . . . with her until she gave birth to a Son And he gave Him the name . . . . . . . . . Jesus
verses.literalPt: e não a conheceu enquanto ela não deu à luz um filho, a quem pôs o nome de JESUS.
